# scm_dlp_config_import_job (Data Source)

Reads the status and conflict details of an Enterprise DLP configuration import job (/v1/api/configuration/import/job/{id}).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the status of a config import job.
data "scm_dlp_config_import_job" "latest" {
  import_job_id = "REPLACE_WITH_JOB_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `import_job_id` (String) Configuration import job ID.

### Read-Only

- `result_json` (String) Raw JSON response from GET /v1/api/configuration/import/job/{id}.
- `status` (String) Import job status.
- `tfid` (String) Terraform ID.
